newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Cullinan warns on fall in net asset value.
newsitem.headline: Cullinan warns on fall in net asset value.

text.p: Cullinan Holdings Ltd said on Monday that operating losses resulting from a divisional disposal programme coupled with losses on the realisation of assets and ongoing finance charges had considerably diminished the firm's net asset value.
It said that the disposal programme was progressing significantly.

The due diligence exercise relating to the planned purchase of unlisted Midmacor Industries Ltd, announced in a cautionary on May 12, had been completed. A revised proposal from Midmacor had been received and was now being considered, Cullinan said.
Shareholders would be informed once a conclusion had been reached and were advised to continue to exercise caution in their share dealings.
